test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it. 10 5
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Row 1: (20 - 10) ÷ 2 = 10 ÷ 2 = 5
 
• Row 2: (40 - 20) ÷ 2 = 20 ÷ 2 = 10

Similarly,

 
• Row 3: (? - 40) ÷ 2 = 20
 
 
• ⇒ (? - 40) = 20 × 2
 
• ⇒ ? = 40 + 40
 
• ⇒ ? = 80
 
 

Hence, '**80**' is the correct answer.
